description: After the Fox River breakout, Michael, Lincoln and the other escapees scatter across the country while FBI agent Alexander Mahone studies their choices with an intelligence that rivals Michael's. The hunt for freedom becomes entangled with Westmoreland's buried money and the conspiracy they are still trying to expose.

s02e01.description: Eight hours after the breakout, the Fox River escapees scatter under a nationwide manhunt while FBI agent Alexander Mahone begins reading Michael's plan with unnerving precision.

s02e02.description: Michael and Lincoln attempt to free LJ from custody while Mahone closes in, and the other escapees split off into increasingly risky routes of their own.

s02e03.description: Michael and Lincoln use a fiery deception to shake Mahone, while Sucre races toward Maricruz, C-Note tries to reach his family and Bellick enters the hunt for profit.

s02e04.description: Bellick corners Michael and Lincoln over Westmoreland's money, Abruzzi pursues old revenge, and Mahone proves that the fugitives are not the only hunters capable of setting traps.

s02e05.description: The legend of D. B. Cooper's buried five million draws Michael, Lincoln and T-Bag toward Utah while Mahone connects the same clues and Sucre races to stop Maricruz's wedding.

s02e06.description: Michael and Lincoln search a Utah housing development for the buried money as T-Bag insinuates himself into the operation and Mahone's investigation draws closer.

s02e07.description: The fugitives finally reach Westmoreland's buried fortune, Lincoln leaves to find LJ, and Mahone corners Tweener into a choice with deadly consequences.

s02e08.description: Sucre appears to betray the group and flee with the money, Mahone faces scrutiny over Tweener, and Sara fights for her life as the Company tries to erase another loose end.

s02e09.description: Michael investigates Mahone's personal past for leverage, while Lincoln travels with LJ, C-Note's family is squeezed by surveillance and T-Bag returns to an old obsession.

s02e10.description: Michael and Sara finally meet again only to be hunted by both Mahone and Kellerman, while Lincoln receives unexpected family help and Sucre plans his own escape.

s02e11.description: Michael's attempt to secure a getaway plane collapses as Mahone deciphers another clue, while T-Bag settles old scores and Sara faces Kellerman directly.

s02e12.description: A painful family reunion exposes Michael's childhood history as Mahone tracks the route to the escape plane, while C-Note's daughter becomes seriously ill.

s02e13.description: Michael and Lincoln are captured and sent toward Fox River, but Mahone and Kellerman have orders that the brothers never reach a cell, forcing a sudden reversal of alliances.

s02e14.description: Michael, Lincoln and Kellerman try to seize the protected Terrence Steadman while C-Note struggles as a fugitive father and T-Bag traps the Hollander family in his fantasy of domestic life.

s02e15.description: Michael and Lincoln hijack the media narrative to send Sara a coded message, while Bellick endures Fox River from the inmate side and Haywire resurfaces in danger.

s02e16.description: Michael and Sara travel toward a confrontation with the President while Mahone recruits help, T-Bag adopts a new identity and another member of the Fox River Eight falls.

s02e17.description: Michael and Sara turn to Warden Pope for access to evidence against the Company, while Mahone corners another fugitive and C-Note races to save his daughter.

s02e18.description: Michael, Lincoln and Sara obtain evidence that could expose the conspiracy, but Mahone forces an escapee to act as bait while Kellerman prepares his own move against the President.

s02e19.description: Michael confronts President Reynolds with the conspiracy's recorded secrets as Kellerman prepares an assassination and Mahone keeps Sara under pressure.

s02e20.description: Freedom appears within reach for Michael and Lincoln in Panama, but Sara faces a sacrifice, T-Bag's violence follows the money south and Mahone's own crimes begin closing around him.

s02e21.description: Michael hunts T-Bag through Panama while Bellick pursues the missing millions, Lincoln and Mahone collide, and Sara's trial forces Kellerman to decide where his loyalty ends.

s02e22.description: In Panama, Michael races to rescue Lincoln and outmaneuver Mahone while Sucre searches for Maricruz and the surviving players converge on a final chain of reversals.
